lines.zh: 发出低沉的鸣响，音柱轻移。
lines.en: Rumbles with a low sound as it moves.

lines.zh: 声音中带着音符，行走间如风行。
lines.en: Sounds filled with notes, walking like a breeze.

lines.zh: 挥动长剑，脚步声震动大地。
lines.en: Swings its sword, footsteps shaking the ground.

lines.zh: 发出空灵的呼吸声，轻盈移动。
lines.en: Breathes with ethereal sounds, moving lightly.

lines.zh: 长剑划破空气，脚步无声。
lines.en: Sword slices air, footsteps silent.
The sound column moves, echoing around.

lines.zh: 步伐坚定，音符在空中飘荡。
lines.en: Steady steps, notes floating in the air.
Dancing sword, moving gracefully.

lines.zh: 脚步轻盈，犹如音符跳跃。
lines.en: Light steps, like notes jumping.

lines.zh: 呼吸间带起音符，行走成诗。
lines.en: Breath carries notes, walking in verse.

lines.zh: 我踏着拍子走，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I walk to a beat, my steps light.
The blade at my hip chimes with each step.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，发出微弱声音。
lines.en: Stands quietly, emitting a soft sound.

lines.zh: 静静驻足，周围回荡其声音。
lines.en: Pauses quietly, its voice echoing around.

lines.zh: 静立不动，却能听到其呼吸。
lines.en: Stands still, yet breath can be heard.

lines.zh: 沉默中蕴含着巨大的力量。
lines.en: Silence harbors great power.

lines.zh: 静默中发出低沉的呼吸声。
lines.en: Low breathing sounds in silence.
Silent and calm breathing.
Quietly standing, breathing steady.
Standing calmly, breathing slowly.
Still, breath faint.
Breathing steady, voice soft.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，发出警戒的声音。
lines.en: Detects player, emits a cautionary sound.

lines.zh: 注意玩家，低声发出警告。
lines.en: Notices player, whispers a warning.

lines.zh: 我的谱面，已经读到第三拍。
lines.en: My score is already at the third beat.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，声音低沉而警告。
lines.en: Detects player, voice low and warning.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，低语警告。
lines.en: Notices player, whispers a warning.

lines.zh: 声音低沉，警告玩家靠近。
lines.en: Low voice, warns player to stay away.
Sharp gaze, emits a warning sound.
Notices player, whispers a warning.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着玩家，低声警告。
lines.en: Stares at player, whispers a warning.

lines.zh: 低沉的警告声响起，提醒玩家。
lines.en: Low warning sound, reminding player.

lines.zh: 音柱受伤了，你打不过我！
lines.en: The Sound Pillar is hurt! You can’t beat me!
Wounded, but the Sound Pillar will not give up!
Injured, don't underestimate me!
Injured, but still strong!

lines.zh: 我被伤到了，你没那么容易赢！
lines.en: I’m injured, but you won’t win easily!
I’m injured, but I’m still standing!
Injured, but the Sound Pillar won’t die!
Injured, but I won’t give up!
Wounded, but the Sound Pillar won’t fall!
Just a scrape, nothing to worry about.

lines.zh: 听到美食诱惑，你动了心？
lines.en: Tempted by the treat?
No escape from the treat.

lines.zh: 你无法抵挡美食的诱惑。
lines.en: Tempted by the food.
Calling you with food.

lines.zh: 美味的召唤让你无法抗拒。
lines.en: Can't resist the food call.
Food you can't resist.
Can't resist the call.

lines.zh: 美食就在眼前，你心动了吗？
lines.en: Food in front of you, tempted?

lines.zh: 美食诱惑，你怎能不心动？
lines.en: Food temptation, can't you feel it?
Food you can't resist.
You collided with my territory.
Don't touch my territory.

lines.zh: 我的领地你最好不要碰。
lines.en: Stay away from my territory.
Don't invade my territory.

lines.zh: 小心，我的领地不容侵犯。
lines.en: Be careful, my territory is sacred.
My territory, don't touch.
Sound Breathing, first form!
My territory, don't touch.
Don't touch my territory.

lines.zh: 我的领地，你最好不要碰。
lines.en: Stay away from my territory.
You're not my mate.
Stay away from my mate.
Don't bother my mate.
You're disrupting my mate.
Don't touch my mate.
Stay away from my mate.
Don't compete with my mate.

lines.zh: 我的配偶是独一无二的。
lines.en: My mate is unique.

lines.zh: 我的配偶你最好不要碰。
lines.en: Don't touch my mate.

lines.zh: 我的妻子们，谁也不许碰。
lines.en: No one touches my wives.

lines.zh: 空洞的回响中，你捡起了一块枯骨。
lines.en: A hollow echo carries the sound of a picked bone.

lines.zh: 这声音来自地下的骸骨。
lines.en: The sound comes from the bones below.
I feel your touch.

lines.zh: 这是我的碎片，你捡到了。
lines.en: This is my fragment, you've found it.
You took a part of me.

lines.zh: 我曾是天元，现在只剩骨头。
lines.en: I was once the Heavens Pillar, now only bones.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我的骨头太冷了。
lines.en: Don't touch me, my bones are too cold.

lines.zh: 你拿走了一块我曾经的一部分。
lines.en: You took a piece of what I once was.

lines.zh: 这些骨头告诉我，我是谁。
lines.en: These bones tell me who I am.
You took my memory.
Prey appears in my sight.
Your heartbeat skipped a beat.

lines.zh: 爆炸玉在我指间转了一圈。
lines.en: A burst bead rolls across my fingers.
My blade is faster than sound.
The prey tastes good.
Flamboyantly, I choose you.

lines.zh: 音律把鬼的位置告诉我了。
lines.en: The rhythm tells me where the demon is.
The ribbon winds tight around my wrist.

lines.zh: 音之呼吸，把你的脚步听清。
lines.en: Sound Breathing reads your every footstep.

lines.zh: 我会让你尝尝音之呼吸。
lines.en: I'll let you taste the Sound Breath.
This demon's breathing is out of tempo.
Let me hear your heartbeat.
The stench of demons is all through the wind.
When the rhythm breaks, I move.
You are covered in the smell of demons.
I count the beat as I close in.

lines.zh: 你会在我剑下化为灰烬。
lines.en: You'll be reduced to ashes under my blade.

lines.zh: 你逃不出我的攻击范围。
lines.en: You can't escape my range.
You'll tremble at my feet.

lines.zh: 我将用音之呼吸斩断你。
lines.en: I'll sever you with Sound Breath.
I'll let you taste my blade.

lines.zh: 你会成为我剑下的亡魂。
lines.en: You'll be a ghost beneath my sword.
Sound Breathing — hear the rhythm.
You'll be in my control.
You'll be destroyed by me.
I heard it on the first beat.
You dodge fast, but the sound stays put.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，数到三。
lines.en: I count your heartbeats up to three.
The blade is out; the sound arrives first.

lines.zh: 你逃不出我的听力范围。
lines.en: You cannot escape my hearing.
Sound Breathing, First Form: Boom.
I tilt my head aside from your claw.

lines.zh: 再近半步，就进我的刀圈。
lines.en: Half a step more and you enter my blade's reach.
Every sound in this clearing is mine.
Your breathing is far too loud.
Sssss, enemy coming!
Prepare to face Tengen!
Swing sword, cut down the evil!
Sound Breath, Slash!
Use your strength, come on!

lines.zh: 我的双刀节奏已经起了。
lines.en: The rhythm of my twin blades has started.
Your bones will turn to dust!
Tengen's sword, cuts through all!
Feel my sword intent!
Power of the Sound Pillar!
One horizontal slash, and the sound bursts outward.
Where the blade passes, sound explodes.
I cut on the beat.
The blast follows my blade.
Sound Slash, unbroken, follow up.
I swing and split the demon in two.
The blade flashes; the sound comes after.
One beat is cut; the next is coming.

lines.zh: 这里将是你最后的栖息地！
lines.en: This will be your final resting place!
Welcome to my world!
I step out of the flash.
Sound and power gather!
Souls tremble here!
I will forever guard here!
This is the end for evil spirits!
My sword point will guide you!
This is the domain of the Sound Pillar!

lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的世界，恶鬼！
lines.en: Welcome to my world, evil spirit!
The Sound Hashira is here; demons scatter.
I am here. Quiet down in these mountains.
One footfall, and I show myself.
A flashy entrance. Do not blink.
Burned by fire, the Sound Pillar is damaged!

lines.zh: 音柱受伤了，你打不过我，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: The Sound Pillar is hurt! You can’t beat me! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 伤痕累累，音柱不服，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wounded, but the Sound Pillar will not give up! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 受伤了，别小看了我，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, don't underestimate me! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被投射物击中，音柱受伤！
lines.en: Hit by a projectile, the Sound Pillar is injured!
Struck by magic, the Sound Pillar is injured!

lines.zh: 音柱饥饿，快给我吃东西！
lines.en: The Sound Pillar is hungry, give me food!

lines.zh: 雷击伤了音柱，痛苦难忍！
lines.en: The Sound Pillar is struck by lightning, in great pain!

lines.zh: 受伤了，但还很强，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, but still strong! — and the void makes it worse.
